contexts.text: They who have lived a good civil and moral life, but have persuaded themselves that they would merit Heaven through their works... seem to themselves to be cutting grass. (Under Sawing, see this reference.)

In the Lower Earth... are they who have placed merit in good works. Many of them seem to themselves to be cutting wood... If they do not receive more joy than others they are indignant with the Lord; wherefore, while they are cutting wood, there sometimes appears as if there were something of the Lord under the wood... AC 8740.
Thou shalt cut the ram into pieces () = interior things arranged distinctly in order... To cut into pieces = the arrangement in order of the interior things. Explained.
Truth cannot be cut in two...
The calf being cut into two parts () = the good proceeding from the Lord on the one side, and the good received by man on the other; whence comes conjunction.
